bugs.summary: choose.dir() returns NA without showing a dialog in Rterm/Rscript
bugs.creator: kevinushey

comments.creator: kevinushey
comments.text:
Since R 4.3.0, `utils::choose.dir()` returns `NA` immediately, without
showing the folder-selection dialog, whenever R is run via Rterm or
Rscript (and therefore also in front ends that embed or drive Rterm,
e.g. RStudio and VS Code). Under Rgui the dialog appears as expected.

To reproduce, from Rterm (or Rscript) on Windows:

```
> utils::choose.dir()
[1] NA
```

No dialog is shown. There is a curious workaround, originally noticed
by users: call `file.choose()` first (it can be cancelled), after which
`choose.dir()` works normally for the rest of the session.

## Analysis

In R 4.3.0, `askcdstring()` in `src/extra/graphapp/dialogs.c` (the helper
behind `choose.dir()` and Rgui's "Change working directory" dialog) was
rewritten from `SHBrowseForFolder()` to the COM-based `IFileOpenDialog`.
The new code calls

```
res = CoCreateInstance(&CLSID_FileOpenDialog, NULL, CLSCTX_INPROC_SERVER,
                 &IID_IFileOpenDialog, (void **)&fileOpen);
```

but COM is never initialized on the calling thread (there is no
`CoInitialize`/`CoInitializeEx`/`OleInitialize` call anywhere in graphapp or
gnuwin32). In Rterm/Rscript nothing else has initialized COM, so
`CoCreateInstance` fails with `CO_E_NOTINITIALIZED`, and `askcdstring()`
returns `NULL`, which `chooseDir()` maps to `NA` -- indistinguishable from
the user cancelling the dialog.

This also explains the observed behavior elsewhere:

- The `file.choose()` workaround works because `askfilenames()` goes
  through `GetOpenFileNameW()`, which initializes COM on the calling
  thread as a side effect; once that has happened, `CoCreateInstance`
  succeeds.

- Rgui is unaffected, presumably because something during GUI startup
  initializes COM on the main thread as a side effect.

The fix is for `askcdstring()` to initialize COM itself, as documented
for callers of `CoCreateInstance`. Per the `CoInitializeEx` documentation,
`S_FALSE` (already initialized in this apartment) and `RPC_E_CHANGED_MODE`
(already initialized with a different threading model) both mean COM
is usable on the thread; a successful call (`S_OK` or `S_FALSE`) must be
balanced by `CoUninitialize`, while `RPC_E_CHANGED_MODE` must not be.

## Patch

Against R-devel (r90194):

```
Index: src/extra/graphapp/dialogs.c
===================================================================
--- src/extra/graphapp/dialogs.c	(revision 90194)
+++ src/extra/graphapp/dialogs.c	(working copy)
@@ -757,7 +757,7 @@
 
 char *askcdstring(const char *question, const char *default_str)
 {
-    HRESULT res;
+    HRESULT res, initres;
     IFileOpenDialog *fileOpen = NULL;
     IShellItem *dirsi = NULL;
     DWORD flags = 0;
@@ -768,6 +768,15 @@
     wquestion = mbstowcs_malloc(question);
     wdefault_str = mbstowcs_malloc(default_str);
 
+    /* COM may not have been initialized on this thread (it is not in
+       Rterm/Rscript), in which case CoCreateInstance below fails with
+       CO_E_NOTINITIALIZED and no dialog is shown.  S_FALSE and
+       RPC_E_CHANGED_MODE mean COM is already initialized on this
+       thread, which is fine; a successful call (S_OK or S_FALSE) must
+       be balanced by CoUninitialize. */
+    initres = CoInitializeEx(NULL,
+	                     COINIT_APARTMENTTHREADED | COINIT_DISABLE_OLE1DDE);
+
     res = CoCreateInstance(&CLSID_FileOpenDialog, NULL, CLSCTX_INPROC_SERVER,
                      &IID_IFileOpenDialog, (void **)&fileOpen);
     
@@ -805,7 +814,9 @@
 	free(wquestion);
     if (wdefault_str)
 	free(wdefault_str);
-    return ok ? strbuf : NULL; 
+    if (initres == S_OK || initres == S_FALSE)
+	CoUninitialize();
+    return ok ? strbuf : NULL;
 }
 
 char *askpassword(const char *question, const char *default_str)
```

Notes on the patch:

- `COINIT_APARTMENTTHREADED` matches what the common dialogs
  (`GetOpenFileName`) use and is the appropriate model for a thread
  showing UI; `COINIT_DISABLE_OLE1DDE` is the usual companion flag.

- Rgui's use of `askcdstring()` ("Change working directory") is
  unaffected: if COM is already initialized on the thread,
  `CoInitializeEx` returns `S_FALSE` (or `RPC_E_CHANGED_MODE`) and the
  balancing rule above leaves the caller's COM state untouched.

Downstream reports of this issue include
https://github.com/rstudio/rstudio/issues/13078 (also describing the
same behavior in VS Code).

Created attachment 3974
patch: initialize COM in askcdstring() so choose.dir() works in Rterm/Rscript

Patch attached: the fix from the report as a proper SVN diff against r90794 (dialogs.c is unchanged since r90194), with a shorter source comment.

I've now tested it on Windows 11 with a build of the patched sources, cancelling the dialog from a script: under Rscript, choose.dir() shows the dialog, also on a second call in the same session, where R 4.6.1 returns NA at once; Rgui shows it as before.

Patch also at https://github.com/r-devel/r-svn/pull/438, where CI results can be seen.
